rv.q: It’s an insightful and effective innovation in director Carl Cofield’s otherwise straightforward—and effectively streamlined—staging.
For its latest annual summertime offering of performances free to the public, Classical Theatre of Harlem delivers a solid open-air revival of Othello at the Amphitheatre in Marcus Garvey Park.

cn.t: Classical Theatre of Harlem's outdoor Othello delivers a solid, serviceable production that critics find competent if unexceptional, with performances anchored by strong leads in a free summer staging.
